package fixture

import (
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"

	"example.invalid/schema/internal/testproc"
)

// the bounded twin of compiled_helper: the build and the run both go through
// testproc, so neither can outlive the test
func buildAndRun(t *testing.T, dir string) string {
	t.Helper()
	build := testproc.Command(t, "cargo", "build", "--release", "--offline")
	build.Dir = dir
	if out, err := build.CombinedOutput(); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("cargo build: %v\n%s", err, out)
	}
	out, err := testproc.Command(t, filepath.Join(dir, "target", "release", "probe")).Output()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("probe: %v", err)
	}
	return string(out)
}
